Class PostClient

java.lang.Object
org.kgromov.json.placeholder.client.PostClient
public class PostClient extends Object
Client for interacting with the Post resources in the JSON Placeholder API. Provides methods to retrieve posts and posts by user.

      public List<Post> getPage(org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageRequest)

      Parameters:
      pageRequest - the page request
      Returns:
      a list of entities in the specified page
